dedupe_keys.name: cn n china crop specific nitrogen application rates

description: The CN-N version 1 record provides annual nitrogen application rates for rice, wheat and maize in China from 2004 through 2016. The authors combined county and provincial agricultural statistics with gridded crop distribution maps. The resulting 1 km GeoTIFF maps are archived in a Zenodo ZIP, with a separate R code file. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0 and free public access. Rates are an estimate of agricultural inputs, not a measurement at each farm or a current fertilizer-use feed. The article reports comparison with farmer surveys; the original survey data and the map files were not downloaded or independently checked here. CN-N can supply historical fertilizer inputs to crop, irrigation-water-quality and food-production simulations. It does not directly measure nitrate in rivers or treatment costs. Coverage is national but crop-specific; users need to account for crop-mask, statistics and allocation errors. It complements data-china-maize-wheat-yield-water-productivity-1km, which describes crop output, not nitrogen input.
